en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.833 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub asked Imam Abu al-Hasan (as) about gypsum (plaster) that was fired using dung and the bones of the dead, and whether it would be permissible to prostrate on it if a mosque was plastered with it.
The Imam wrote back in his own handwriting: "Fire and water have purified it”.
